eligibility.quote:
rosrun tf2_ros static_transform_publisher  1 2 3 0 0 0 1 parent child

rosrun tf2_tools view_frames.py

It doesn't show the parent and child in this case, just shows no frames received.
eligibility.reason: Two independently executable ROS nodes are paired. The missing subscription and static-aware buffer insertion are a consumer interface implementation failure. The fix changes code and static-transform handling; it is not simply a deployment remap.

failed_conditions.quote:
rospy.Subscriber("/tf", TFMessage, self.callback)
+        rospy.Subscriber("/tf_static", TFMessage, self.static_callback)
failed_conditions.reason: other correctly describes missing static-transform support, with no documented removal or retyping. /tf is an existing, unchanged dynamic-transform subscription, not an interaction supplied by this static publisher. The failed element of this pair is /tf_static, not /tf.

loudness.quote: It doesn't show the parent and child in this case, just shows no frames received.
loudness.reason: The empty result is visible, but there is no diagnostic identifying a missing subscription or incompatible interface. A no-data result is not itself an interface-checking diagnostic under the supplied definition.
